title: residual of r1 B2: the Error arm of AppCompletedRefcheckExport is still unpinned — only the Ok arm gained a firing test
detail: grep-verified: this is the ONLY test dispatch of AppCompletedRefcheckExport. The Error arm (client.gleam:3531-3536: `True, Error(_) -> add_toast(Model(..model, clipboard_copied: None), copy.refcheck_toast_export_failed, ToastError)`) fires refcheck_toast_export_failed with no pin anywhere. r1 B2's recommended fix explicitly included 'plus the Error arm'.
recommended_fix: Add a test dispatching AppCompletedRefcheckExport("rc-1", Error(Nil)) on a current route asserting the toast equals copy.refcheck_toast_export_failed.
